answer.origin: MarketWise analyst James Royal (published 2026-07-28) relaying Wall Street Journal reporting; the WSJ original publication day and event time are not stated.
answer.note: The source is a secondhand analyst column dated 2026-07-28 that relays a WSJ report that NVIDIA was working on a $350 billion deal to finance NVIDIA chips for OpenAI. It supports only that financing talks of about $350 billion, tied to OpenAI processor purchases, were being reported by the WSJ as of late July 2026. It does not add a primary source, a date, a project name, or a signing status. Its amount matches the approximately $350 billion talks reported by GuruFocus and Al Jazeera on 2026-07-27, so it is best read as a further relay of the same reporting cluster rather than independent confirmation. The Huang statement reported later by 24/7 Wall St. (that the talks concerned a non-binding memorandum of understanding rather than NVIDIA funding the whole project) weighs against treating a binding financing commitment as established. The source leaves the v27 forecast unchanged: a lean toward a binding agreement by 2026-12-31 remains a forecast, not an established outcome.
limitations: The WSJ original article, its publication date, and its full text are not available; the claim is secondhand through an analyst column.
The source does not state the project, the chip volume, or the terms, so it cannot confirm the Ohio scope used in v27.
No signing status is disclosed for any NVIDIA-OpenAI financing; this is unknown, not unsigned.
The $350 billion figure is a reported talks size, not a committed amount or a disclosed agreement value.
The relationship between this WSJ-attributed report and the GuruFocus and Al Jazeera reports is not established as a common original source.
follow_up: Locate the original Wall Street Journal article on the $350 billion NVIDIA-OpenAI financing talks and record its publication date and exact wording on scope and project.
Check NVIDIA and OpenAI statements, filings, or press releases for any binding financing agreement covering OpenAI processor purchases for the Ohio project through 2026-12-31.
Check whether the non-binding memorandum of understanding described by Jensen Huang has been converted into a definitive agreement, and when.
Check whether any later reporting by WSJ, Bloomberg, or Reuters gives a signing date, counterparties, or terms for the financing.
